moments.title: Black Friday Sales Begin
moments.blurb: Black Friday 2026 officially falls on November 27th, but many UK retailers are launching their sales events from today, running through to Cyber Monday on November 30th.

angles.name: Early Deals Alert
angles.copy: Black Friday is officially next Friday, but the deals are already dropping! Keep an eye out for those early bird bargains across the UK. What's on your wishlist this year?

angles.name: Shopping Weekend Kick-off
angles.copy: The biggest shopping weekend of the year is unofficially starting NOW! From tech to fashion, UK retailers are going big. Are you diving into the sales or waiting for the 27th?

moments.title: Joe Walsh Turns 79
moments.blurb: Legendary guitarist, singer, and songwriter Joe Walsh, known for his work with the Eagles, James Gang, and a successful solo career, celebrates his 79th birthday today.

angles.name: Rock Legend Birthday
angles.copy: Happy 79th Birthday to the one and only Joe Walsh! From the James Gang to the Eagles and his brilliant solo work, his guitar riffs are iconic. What's your favourite Joe Walsh track?

angles.name: Eagles Guitar Hero
angles.copy: Celebrating the incredible Joe Walsh today as he turns 79! The Eagles' guitar hero has given us some of rock's most memorable moments. Tune in for a classic!

moments.title: Brixham Lanterns, Lights and Luminations
moments.blurb: The popular Lanterns, Lights and Luminations event kicks off today in Brixham, South Devon, featuring a magical lantern parade, fireworks, live music, and a market.

angles.name: Brixham Lights On
angles.copy: Brixham is lighting up! The Lanterns, Lights and Luminations event starts today, bringing a dazzling parade, fireworks, and festive cheer to the harbour. Don't miss it!

angles.name: Devon Festive Fun
angles.copy: Looking for some festive magic this weekend in Devon? Brixham's Lanterns, Lights and Luminations is on today and tomorrow with live music and a market. Get down there!

moments.title: Remembering Tina Turner's Birthday
moments.blurb: On November 26th, we remember the legendary 'Queen of Rock 'n' Roll', Tina Turner, who would have celebrated her 87th birthday. She passed away in May 2023.

angles.name: Queen of Rock 'n' Roll
angles.copy: Next Thursday, November 26th, we celebrate the enduring legacy of the phenomenal Tina Turner, who would have been 87. Her voice, energy, and spirit remain unmatched. What's your favourite Tina hit?

angles.name: Simply The Best Tribute
angles.copy: Thinking of the one and only Tina Turner next week on what would have been her 87th birthday. A true icon whose music continues to inspire. Let's blast some 'Simply The Best'!

moments.title: Remembering Jimi Hendrix's Birthday
moments.blurb: On November 27th, we honour the unparalleled genius of Jimi Hendrix, who would have been 84. His revolutionary guitar playing continues to influence generations.

angles.name: Guitar God's Legacy
angles.copy: Next Friday, November 27th, would have been the 84th birthday of the legendary Jimi Hendrix. His groundbreaking sound changed music forever. What's your favourite Hendrix riff?

angles.name: Purple Haze Memories
angles.copy: Remembering the extraordinary talent of Jimi Hendrix on what would have been his 84th birthday next week. A true pioneer whose music is as vibrant today as ever.

moments.title: Dartmouth Christmas Lights Switch-On
moments.blurb: Dartmouth's Christmas lights will be switched on next Friday, November 27th, followed by Santa's arrival by boat and a Christmas market in the Royal Avenue gardens.

angles.name: Dartmouth Sparkles
angles.copy: Next Friday, Dartmouth lights up for Christmas! The festive switch-on is happening, complete with Santa arriving by boat and a wonderful Christmas market. Who's going?

angles.name: Festive Fun in Devon
angles.copy: Get ready for a magical weekend in Dartmouth! Christmas lights switch-on, a visit from Santa, and a market all kick off next Friday. Perfect for getting into the festive spirit!

moments.title: Buckfast Abbey Christmas Market
moments.blurb: Buckfast Abbey is hosting its biggest Christmas Market yet from Thursday, November 26th to Saturday, November 28th, featuring more stalls and festive delights.

angles.name: Abbey Festive Market
angles.copy: Get your Christmas shopping started at Buckfast Abbey! Their biggest Christmas Market ever runs from next Thursday to Saturday. Support local and find unique gifts!

angles.name: Devon Christmas Shopping
angles.copy: Looking for festive markets? Buckfast Abbey's huge Christmas Market kicks off next Thursday! A perfect chance to soak up the atmosphere and find those special presents.

moments.title: Father Christmas Experience at The Big Sheep
moments.blurb: The Big Sheep in North Devon launches its new Father Christmas Experience on Saturday, November 28th, offering a festive adventure for families.

angles.name: Meet Santa in Devon
angles.copy: Santa's coming to The Big Sheep! Their brand new Father Christmas Experience opens next Saturday, November 28th. Get ready for some magical family fun!

angles.name: North Devon Christmas
angles.copy: Planning a festive outing with the kids? The Big Sheep's Father Christmas Experience starts next Saturday. It's going to be a brilliant Christmas adventure!
